full_judgment: 19. The trial court, thereafter, decided issue Nos. 1, 4, 5 and 6 and found that admittedly Abdul Wahed Howlader was the original owner of the suit land and R.S. and S.A. Khatian was rightly prepared in their names exhibit-1 series. Abdul Wahed Howlader sold 0.50 acres of land to the predecessor of the plaintiffs Abdul Aziz on 01.02.1965 vide registered deed No. 673 exhibit-4 of the same date Abdul Aziz Molla executed and registered an Ekrarnama in favour of Abdul Wahed Howlader for 7 years exhibit-(Ka).
